title: Packed authenticated order projection
objective: Authenticate one fused field-analysis payload in one source-transparent crossing and return an immutable lazily materialized NumberFieldOrder projection with exact corruption differentials and phase benchmarks

oracles: existing generic field-analysis decoder and lattice checker

handoff.summary: The ordinary public maximal-order path now borrows the field-owned sealed integral polynomial, authenticates one packed projection, installs an immutable lazy NumberFieldOrder, and defers decomposition, basis rows, witnesses, and certificate serialization. Reusable shape-keyed native scratch removes allocator cost without caching any proof result. All three 101-sample warm-public medians are below 2ms (1.572ms cubic, 1.443ms essential cubic, 1.714ms degree 7).
risks: The shape-keyed scratch buffers assume synchronous kernel calls within one JavaScript isolate; worker isolates have independent module state.
The degree-7 p90 was 2.044ms although the explicit median gate is green.
next_steps: Integrate onto maximal-order and rebuild the production native registry so its source hash matches field_analysis_resource.py.
Run pnpm test:native and the full maximal-order benchmark corpus after integration to watch tail latency outside the ordinary microcases.
